text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police take measures to ensure that tonight's peace concert between Greek singer Sakis Rouvas and Turkish singer Burak Kut will proceed smoothly.

- Foreign Minister Yiannakis Cassoulides expresses reservations on the direct talks scheduled to be held between President Glafcos Clerides and Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash because of the inadequate preparation for the meeting.
- Communist party leader Demetris Christofias criticises the government for its political, social and economic policies.
- Three British soldiers are killed in a horrific crash on the Dhekelia - Ayia Napa road.
- The United Nations and other foreign mediators on the Cyprus problem expect that only a miracle can breach the deadlock on the essence of the Cyprus dispute.
- The Americans have devised a "green line" plan for the partition of the Aegean in the framework of confidence-building measures between Greece and Turkey.
